description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

hooks.command: engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then echo 'Impeccable hook setup required: run node scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs from a reviewed checkout.' >&2; exit 1; fi; "$engine" hook

engine="$HOME/.impeccable/vaultdex/engine-0.1.5/impeccable"; case "${OSTYPE:-}" in msys*|cygwin*) engine="$engine.exe";; esac; if [ ! -x "$engine" ]; then echo 'Impeccable hook setup required: run node scripts/install-impeccable-hooks.mjs from a reviewed checkout.' >&2; exit 1; fi; "$engine" hook

node -e "const p=require('node:path').join(require('node:os').homedir(),'.ponytail','vaultdex','4.10.0-5','.agents','hooks','ponytail-activate.js');if(require('node:fs').existsSync(p)){process.argv.splice(1,0,p);require(p)}else{console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'Ponytail hooks fehlen: Nach Checkout-Pruefung node scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs ausfuehren; danach Hooks freigeben.',hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'Ponytail hooks fehlen: Nach Checkout-Pruefung node scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs ausfuehren; danach Hooks freigeben.'}}))}" -- claude "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

node -e "const p=require('node:path').join(require('node:os').homedir(),'.ponytail','vaultdex','4.10.0-5','.agents','hooks','ponytail-activate.js');if(require('node:fs').existsSync(p)){process.argv.splice(1,0,p);require(p)}else{console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'Ponytail hooks fehlen: Nach Checkout-Pruefung node scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs ausfuehren; danach Hooks freigeben.',hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SessionStart',additionalContext:'Ponytail hooks fehlen: Nach Checkout-Pruefung node scripts/install-ponytail-hooks.mjs ausfuehren; danach Hooks freigeben.'}}))}" -- claude "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" continue
